topic: Capstone Demonstration, Portfolio, UX Case Study, and Future Roadmap
learningObjectives: Present a complete full stack project and explain its technical architecture.
Document the UI/UX design process and key implementation decisions.
Identify future improvements and communicate the project's development roadmap.

activities.title: Capstone Story Map
activities.instruction: Arrange the key sections of a project presentation.

content.concept: A strong project presentation connects the problem, users, solution, architecture, implementation, results, and future improvements.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Technical Architecture Review
activities.instruction: Build the architecture diagram for the final project.

content.concept: Technical architecture communicates how the frontend, backend, database, external services, and deployment components work together.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: UX Case Study Builder
activities.instruction: Compose the major sections of a UX case study.

content.concept: A UX case study documents the problem, research, design process, iterations, implementation, and resulting user experience.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Project Review Checklist
activities.instruction: Select the evidence needed for final project review.

content.concept: A final review can cover functionality, code quality, UI consistency, accessibility, testing, deployment, documentation, and presentation readiness.
